versions.content: Activation/Deactivation of PduActivationRoutingGroup s The routing of Pdu s to and from a socket may be activated or deactivated with a PduActivationRoutingGroup depending on the availability of AbstractServi- ceInstance s, EventHandler s or ConsumedEventGroup s that send or receive the data.
